title: Magic state cultivation: growing T states as cheap as CNOT gates
conversion_notes: Generate the Y-basis injection/cultivation circuit; replace the specific S and S_DAG rotations standing in for T and T_DAG, respectively, not unrelated Clifford S gates. The paper's Figure 7 describes this replacement. Check non-Clifford detector/observable behavior and feedback. Independently converted d=3 and d=5 extended-Stim files are linked in SymFT_Test, derived from Clifft.
notes: Author repository generates unitary, Bell, and teleport injection plus cultivation and escape circuits. Paper notes that S-proxy results need not faithfully predict T-circuit behavior. SymFT's d=7 extension is explicitly unverified and is not an author release. Sources: https://arxiv.org/html/2409.17595 and https://github.com/haoliri0/SymFT_Test/blob/main/benchmark/README.md.

title: Magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor
authors: Rosenfeld, Gidney, Roberts, Morvan, Lacroix, et al.
conversion_notes: The release explicitly states stim_X.stim and stim_Z.stim replace non-Clifford rotations by Clifford operations. Compare each with the corresponding cirq_circuit_X/Z.json to restore the actual rotations, accounting for echo-frame reversals and tagged H_YZ conjugations. Validate detectors and tomography separately.
notes: Author dataset contains experimental circuits and raw data in fig2/fig3/fig4 archives; total 3.2 GB, not downloaded. README confirms formats and substitution; paper's data availability links the dataset. Color-code injection, cultivation and grafting to surface code.

title: Low-overhead magic state distillation with color codes
conversion_notes: Use color-code-stim's cult+growing option (d=3 or 5) for the Gidney-style cultivation stage, and restore the magic-state rotations following the original cultivation construction; exact replacement sites and detector interpretation require inspection. This is not the complete 15-to-1 distillation circuit.
notes: The paper's v5 adds integrated cultivation-plus-growing simulations. Author's package explicitly implements this circuit type. The separate msd-magic-state-prep-cycle-simulation repo is a classical timing/availability model, not a quantum circuit generator; do not confuse it with a released factory circuit.

title: Color code decoder with improved scaling for correcting circuit-level noise
conversion_notes: Current package generates cult+growing circuits based on Gidney et al. for distance 3 or 5, and supports superdense extraction. Identify and convert the cultivation rotations from Clifford stand-ins following the original construction; inspect exact sites and validate. Original paper's memory circuits require adding a magic-state injection stage.
notes: The cultivation feature was added after this decoder paper and is not a circuit studied in the original publication; it is author-released follow-on code. Repository documents a correction to its old bit-flip model and says circuit-level results are unaffected.

title: Efficient Magic State Cultivation on the Surface Code
conversion_notes: Inspect 2025/HCultivationSurfaceCode/simulation.py and its injection and controlled-operation constructions, comparing full state-vector and Stim variants to restore non-Clifford operations; no safe general gate-by-gate substitution has been verified.
notes: Comparative candidate: protocol cultivates on surface codes instead of color codes. Repository provides Stim generators, full state-vector code and a modified copy of Gidney's color-code cultivation code; generated files described in circuits/ but committed files not independently confirmed.

title: Scaling and logic in the color code on a superconducting quantum processor
conversion_notes: The released d=3/d=5 superdense memory circuits are potential bases for injection: add physical state preparation and encoding per the paper's state injection circuit, then adjust detectors and logical readout. The listed dataset describes memory experiments, not the injection experiment.
notes: Stim's official circuit-data index links the paper to this author dataset, but the 738.5 MB archive was not downloaded and the dataset describes only memory experiments. Magic-state injection circuits are not verified as released; this is a reconstructable lead, not an asserted exact match.
